messages:
elaine: Quick docs sync — PR #482 adds a couple of sample provisioning payloads for Dedicated capacity. Can someone eyeball the SDK snippet and link hygiene? cc @sam @mike

sam: On it. I glanced at the PR, one of the links to tenant-labels.md is 404 for me.

mike: I also noticed the SDK example still calls `client.allocate()` which is the old helper. Should be `client.create_dedicated({ region, tier })` now.

docs-bot: PR #482: CI checks queued -> running. 

anis: I can do a tiny follow-up to swap the function call and add a short YAML autoscale example for cooldowns if you want.

elaine: That would be perfect — also please add a one-liner explaining SLA fallback behavior when preemption happens (we get asked about it in onboarding).

sam: Re: the broken link — looks like the autoscale schema moved under /docs/provisioning/ last week. The old redirect didn't land. We should update the anchor in the sample to the new path.

mike: I'll push a commit to the branch: 1) replace `allocate` with `create_dedicated`, 2) update the autoscale-schema link to `/docs/provisioning/autoscale-schema.md`, 3) add the eviction preemption note (one paragraph).\n
mike: SDK snippet I'm proposing to replace the block with:
```python
# create a dedicated pool
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
pool = client.create_dedicated(region='us-west-2', tier='reserved-v2')
print(pool.id)
```

elaine: Nice and short. For the YAML autoscale example, keep it minimal — show min/max nodes and cooldown only. No need to show all fields.

anis: Will add a snippet like:
```yaml
autoscale: 
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 10
  cooldown_seconds: 300
```

sam: Once mike pushes, I'll run the examples locally and check the rendered docs preview. If everything looks green, can we merge and backport the link fix to the handbook branch? Some customers still reference that copy.

elaine: Yes, please backport the link change. If CI passes after mike's commit and anis' snippet, go ahead and merge. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #482: CI passed. Reviewers: sam (approved), mike (committed).

sam: I ran the preview; snippet renders fine and the new link resolves. Backport PR opened: #483.

mike: Merged #482. Follow-up #484 contains a tiny wording tweak to the SLA paragraph based on elaine's note.

anis: Follow-up landed with the YAML example. All set from docs side.

elaine: Excellent. Leaving this thread — will update the release notes to mention the snippet and handbook link fix. Thanks!
